node.title: Re^3: Translation Substring Error
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If a nucleotide triplet with an unknown nucleotide appears (ex. ANC instead of ATC), I'd want to either skip those, or mark them with a letter like 'X'.

In the first two solutions, you can use [doc://exists], e.g.:

if ( exists $genetic_code{$codon} ) { $amino_acid .= $genetic_code{$codon}; } else { $amino_acid .= $codon; # - OR - $amino_acid .= 'X'; # or something else... }

Update: Or, written more tersely, either $amino_acid .= exists $genetic_code{$codon} ? $genetic_code{$codon} : 'X'; or $amino_acid .= $genetic_code{$codon} // 'X'; (the former uses the [doc://perlop#Conditional-Operator], and the latter uses [doc://perlop#Logical-Defined-Or] instead of [doc://exists], assuming you don't have any undef values in your hash).
